name: AWS Global Infrastructure
description: Understanding how AWS is physically and logically organised: Regions, Availability Zones, edge locations and accounts, and how those boundaries shape placement, resilience and compliance decisions.

competencyLevels.descriptor: Can name Regions, AZs and edge locations and say roughly what each is for.
Can explain how the four concepts relate and choose placement for a simple workload with justification.
Has deployed a workload across multiple AZs and picked a Region for a real constraint.
Has operated multi-AZ or multi-Region systems and handled an AZ or Region event.
Designs multi-account, multi-Region topologies balancing isolation, latency, compliance and cost.
